name: visit-checklist-verification
objective: Close field visit, governed location, checklist, evidence, verification and store-readiness lifecycle.
truthOwner: DSH owns visit/checklist/verification/readiness state; Workforce/Identity provide current actor scope; device captures evidence but does not own truth.
journeys: field store visit through readiness verification

tasks.objective: Align field visit actions with the current authoritative state machine and mutation-time scope checks.
tasks.currentProblem: Current UI proves start/checklist/complete/verification paths but not every authoritative terminal/conflict/cancel-or-abandon rule or stale-assignment case.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace contract/backend/domain transitions and implement only authority-backed missing actions/states with version/idempotency and current assignment checks.
tasks.targetState: Every allowed transition is reachable once; illegal/stale/concurrent transitions fail precisely with no persistence drift.
tasks.action: Inspect OpenAPI/handlers/domain/repositories before editing UI; add concurrency/retry/revocation tests at owning layers.
mustNotChange: Do not invent lifecycle states absent from current authority.
Do not trust client assignment or location claims without server checks.
Do not make UI state operational truth.
acceptanceCriteria: Current authoritative lifecycle is fully represented and illegal transitions are rejected.
Concurrent/duplicate/stale requests cannot create duplicate or cross-scope effects.
tasks.rollback: Forward-fix state-machine defects; never restore permissive transitions.

tasks.objective: Close governed location, checklist/evidence and final verification/readiness readback.
tasks.currentProblem: Device prechecks exist, but server geofence/freshness/evidence prerequisites and downstream readiness convergence still require complete proof.
tasks.requiredChange: Verify/correct location proof validation, checklist/evidence rules, open-escalation blockers, verification version/idempotency and store-readiness projection.
tasks.targetState: No verification succeeds with invalid location, missing evidence/checks, open blocker or stale version; authorized readers see committed readiness.
tasks.action: Trace UI evidence to media reference, field API, backend checks, persistence and operator/partner readback; add negative and restart tests.
mustNotChange: No local readiness calculation becomes truth.
No raw unowned media reference acceptance.
acceptanceCriteria: Each location/checklist/evidence blocker has precise code/action and prevents invalid commit.
Verification retry is idempotent or conflict-safe according to contract.
Control-panel/app-partner readback matches committed store readiness after refresh/restart.
tasks.rollback: Revert presentation only if needed; preserve backend validation and evidence lineage.
